reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial pass of 38 B1/B2 verb questions: independently solved every German sentence and reviewed all four offered choices per variant, syntax, separability, inflection, single-answer defensibility, bilingual explanations and distinct contexts. Deferred hingegen because the source misclassifies an adverb as a verb. Clarified herunterfahren dual senses, hinzukommen and infrage kommen glosses, and irren versus sich irren. Inherited examples not copied. Human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approval pending.
